notes:
- **Archie shows an alert on your computer when your agent posts something on its own**, such as a
  reminder, a routine's report, or a card about new mail, while Archie is open behind your other
  windows. Turn it off in Settings, General. Archie Mobile does not buzz yet; a chat app such as
  Telegram is what buzzes your phone.
- **Type stop, or press Stop, while your agent is working.** What it already finished stays done,
  and nothing more happens.
- **A send time your agent suggests for an email is a button on the card.** Nothing is set to send
  until you press it.
- **Ask what your agent got done and it says what each job actually did**, not only what you asked
  for, and whether each email it drafted went out.
- **Ask how many unread emails you have and your agent gives your inbox's own count.** When a list
  it read was cut short, it says so.
- **Your agent says which calendar it reads**: the main calendar of each account you connected, so
  it never calls a day clear. Before it changes your calendar, it names the calendar and the
  guests, and waits for your yes.
- **Your agent asks before opening a web address it came up with itself.** It shows you the
  address first and waits for your yes.
- **Ask your agent how it works and it answers correctly**: what it reads for you goes to the AI
  company along with what you type, Archie Mobile keeps a locked copy of your chat on our servers
  that only your phone can open, and it makes no compliance claim. When it does not know, it says
  where to look.
- **With a model running on your computer**, Archie says what still uses the internet (your mail,
  your calendar, web pages and Archie's own checks) and names the app running the model when it
  stops answering. Moving your agent from that model to an AI company waits for your yes.
- **With Computer control off, ask your agent to buy or cancel something on a website and it names
  the switch that would let it**, and says a purchase would still wait for your tap.
- **On a Mac with Liquid Glass, the sidebar and menus are glass** and follow how see-through you set
  it in System Settings, under Appearance. Settings, General has a button that opens it.
- **A skill or a routine opens where it sits** on the agent page: what it needs before it works,
  your answers, when it last ran and runs next, and Run now.
- **Getting an AI key goes one step at a time**, ending on the box you paste it into. Every Google
  connect button tells you about Google's unverified-app screen before you see it.
- **On the talk screen**, replies read aloud are kept short, it says what the microphone is doing,
  and a long answer scrolls. Turning on Let it talk no longer restarts your agent.
- **Fixed: the calendar showed the week the clocks change as half empty.**
